issues.t: Central "spider" fuel injector trouble
issues.sym: Long cranking before it starts, rough idle, misfires, or a raw gasoline smell.
issues.why: The central injector unit feeds each cylinder through small poppet nozzles and lines that can clog or start leaking with age. A leaking nozzle can flood a cylinder.
issues.next: Have fuel pressure and misfire data checked. If the injector unit is bad it is normally replaced as a complete assembly. Do not ignore a fuel smell.

issues.t: Intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
issues.sym: Coolant level keeps dropping, a sweet smell, coolant on top of the engine, or milky oil.
issues.why: The intake gaskets on these Vortec V8s are known to break down and let coolant seep out, sometimes into the oil.
issues.next: Watch the coolant level closely. If you see milky oil or the engine overheats, stop driving and have the gaskets replaced before the engine is damaged.

issues.t: Throttle may not return to idle (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stays at higher revs after you lift off the gas pedal.
issues.why: The throttle cable could rub on the dash mat and bind.
issues.next: Check that this recall was done. If the throttle sticks, shift to neutral, stop safely and have it towed.

issues.t: Front rotor and hub can crack (recall)
issues.sym: A grinding or clunking noise from a front wheel, vibration, or a wheel that feels loose.
issues.why: Some front rotor and hub castings were made from out-of-spec iron and could crack, which could lead to the wheel coming off.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If you hear new noises from a front wheel, stop driving and have it inspected.

issues.t: Lower steering shaft bolt may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Looseness or clunking in the steering, or steering that stops responding.
issues.why: A pinch bolt on the lower steering shaft could be loose or missing, letting the shaft separate from the steering gear.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Any sudden looseness in the steering means stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Exhaust fumes can get into the cabin (recall)
issues.sym: An exhaust smell inside the vehicle, especially with windows closed.
issues.why: Rear wheelhouse plugs could be loose or missing, letting exhaust gases into the passenger area.
issues.next: Do not drive with an exhaust smell inside. Check your VIN for this recall and have the plugs fixed.

issues.t: Gauges stick, jump, or go dead
issues.sym: The speedometer, fuel, oil pressure, or temperature needle sticks, reads wrong, or drops to zero, sometimes with warning lights flickering.
issues.why: Tiny motors that move the gauge needles in the instrument cluster wear out on these trucks.
issues.next: Have the cluster tested. It can be repaired or replaced. Do not rely on a faulty speedometer or fuel gauge.

issues.t: Heated washer fluid module can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: Smoke or a burning smell from under the hood, or the washers stop working.
issues.why: The heated windshield washer module could short and overheat, with a risk of fire.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls and have them done. If you see smoke, pull over and turn the vehicle off.

issues.t: 5.3L V8 burns oil
issues.sym: You keep adding oil between changes, see a low-oil warning, or notice blue smoke at startup and misfires from fouled plugs.
issues.why: Oil gets past the piston rings and burns. Cylinder deactivation is widely blamed for making it worse. The 2010-2014 LC9 engines were the subject of a certified class action.
issues.next: Check the dipstick at every fill-up and keep it full. Ask a GM dealer to run an oil consumption test and check for bulletins on your VIN.

issues.t: Rear axle cross pin can break (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or grinding from the rear, or the rear wheels locking up.
issues.why: The cross pin inside the rear axle could fracture and cause the axle to lock.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If you hear new rear-end noises, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Steering shaft bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or play in the steering wheel.
issues.why: Bolts on the intermediate steering shaft may not have been tightened properly, risking loss of steering.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it repaired before driving more than necessary.

issues.t: Tie rod may separate from the rack (recall)
issues.sym: Loose or wandering steering, or a clunk when turning.
issues.why: A tie rod on some early 2015 trucks could come apart from the steering rack. GM told owners not to drive until inspected.
issues.next: Do not drive until the recall inspection is done. Check your VIN right away.

issues.t: Transfer case can shift into neutral (recall)
issues.sym: The truck loses drive power or rolls while parked without the parking brake set.
issues.why: An electrical short could shift the transfer case into neutral on its own.
issues.next: Always use the parking brake and check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Transmission cooler line can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Red fluid drips at the front of the truck, a burning smell, or smoke from under the hood.
issues.why: An oil cooler line might not be fully seated and could leak fluid onto hot parts, creating a fire risk.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If you see smoke or smell burning fluid, pull over and shut it off.

issues.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes heavy, then the assist returns with a jerk.
issues.why: The electric power steering could briefly lose assist and then return suddenly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it fixed before regular driving.

issues.t: A/C condenser leaks refrigerant
issues.sym: The air conditioning slowly stops blowing cold and keeps needing recharges.
issues.why: The combined A/C condenser and transmission cooler can crack from heat cycling. GM extended coverage on the condenser for affected VINs.
issues.next: Have a shop leak-test the system, and ask a Chevrolet dealer whether the special coverage still applies.

issues.t: Reduced brake assist from vacuum pump (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal feels hard and stopping takes more effort, often at low speed.
issues.why: The engine-driven vacuum pump for the brake booster can lose output. GM reprogrammed the brake module to use hydraulic assist instead.
issues.next: Check your VIN for these recalls. If the pedal turns hard, drive gently to a safe spot and have it checked before continuing.

issues.t: Unintended braking on one wheel (recall)
issues.sym: The truck suddenly pulls to one side at highway speed.
issues.why: If a wheel-speed sensor fails, the brake system could apply the opposite brake at around highway speeds. The fix reprograms the brake module.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If ABS or traction lights are on, get it checked before highway driving.

issues.t: Magnetic Ride shocks leak or knock
issues.sym: Oily shocks, a knocking or uneven ride, or a "Service Suspension" message.
issues.why: The adaptive shocks on these trucks are known to leak and wear early. GM issued a bulletin for diagnosing them.
issues.next: Have the shocks inspected and the failed ones replaced, and ask the dealer about the bulletin.

issues.t: Cylinder deactivation lifter failure
issues.sym: Ticking or tapping from the engine, misfires and a check engine light, rough idle, or loss of power.
issues.why: The special lifters used to shut off cylinders can stick or collapse, and the camshaft is often damaged with them.
issues.next: Get it diagnosed promptly. Driving with a collapsed lifter can damage the camshaft and spread metal through the engine. Use the correct oil and change it on time.

issues.t: Front upper control arm welds may fail (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk from the front end or steering that feels loose.
issues.why: Welds on the front upper control arm might not have been done properly and could separate. GM told owners not to drive until repaired.
issues.next: Do not drive until the recall repair is done. Check your VIN right away.

issues.t: Missing transfer case part can lock wheels (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning; the front or rear wheels can lock up while driving.
issues.why: A component was left out of some transfer cases, which can make wheels lock without warning.
issues.next: Check your VIN now. If it is included, do not drive it until the dealer repair is done.

issues.t: Fuel pump can over-pressurize and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell, or wetness near the fuel tank area.
issues.why: Some fuel pumps lacked a pressure regulator and could over-pressurize the system, cracking parts and leaking fuel.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, park it and have it towed. Check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: 6.2L engine rod and crankshaft defect (recall)
issues.sym: A knocking that rises with engine speed, a low oil pressure warning, rough running, or the engine shutting off while driving.
issues.why: Supplier defects in the connecting rods and crankshaft can lead to bearing damage and engine failure. GM recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall right away. If you hear knocking or see an oil pressure warning, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: 10-speed harsh shifts, limp mode or "Service Transmission"
issues.sym: Jerky or harsh shifts, a sudden lurch, the truck going into reduced power, or a Service Transmission message.
issues.why: Owners report valve body and control problems in the 10-speed automatic, and harsh shifting is one of the most common Tahoe transmission complaints in these years.
issues.next: Have the transmission scanned and checked for software updates and bulletins. Get it in quickly if it goes into limp mode.

issues.t: Rear wheels can lock up (recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning; the rear wheels can lock while driving.
issues.why: A transmission control valve could fail and lock the rear wheels. The fix is new control software. The 2021 recall covers diesel trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for these recalls and have the software update done right away.

issues.t: Rear driveshaft may fail (recall)
issues.sym: Vibration or clunking from under the truck, then a sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: Internal parts of the rear driveshaft may not have been heat treated properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it fixed soon.

issues.t: Fuel pump control module can fail (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stumbles, loses power, or stalls.
issues.why: A faulty fuel pump control module could stop the fuel pump.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get it done before long trips.

issues.t: Power steering can cut out (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly turns heavy when starting up or while driving.
issues.why: A software problem could cause the power steering assist to stop working.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the update done.

issues.t: Brake calibration problem while towing (recall)
issues.sym: Stability control, ABS or braking feels wrong when towing a trailer.
issues.why: Incorrect brake calibration could affect stability control and ABS while towing.
issues.next: Avoid towing until the recall software update is done.

issues.t: No warning when brake fluid is lost (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal travels farther or braking feels weaker, without a warning light.
issues.why: Brake software might not turn on the warning light when brake fluid leaks out.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If the pedal feels soft, stop driving and have it checked.

issues.t: Wrong fuel tank on some diesels (recall)
issues.sym: Usually none in normal driving.
issues.why: Some diesel trucks got an incorrect fuel tank that could leak fuel in a rollover crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the tank replaced.

issues.t: Front wheel hub bolts may loosen (recall)
issues.sym: Clicking or clunking from a front wheel, or a vibration or wobble.
issues.why: Incorrect hub bolts could loosen or deform, risking loss of control.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If you notice new noises or wobble from a front wheel, stop driving and have it inspected.

issues.t: Missing transfer case part can lock wheels (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning; the front or rear wheels can lock up while driving.
issues.why: A component was left out of some transfer cases, which can make wheels lock without warning.
issues.next: Check your VIN now. If it is included, do not drive it until the dealer repair is done.

issues.t: Clunk felt in the steering wheel (intermediate shaft)
issues.sym: A clunk or thud from under the hood that you can also feel in the steering wheel, mostly at low speed when turning or going over bumps.
issues.why: The slip joint in the intermediate steering shaft between the column and the steering gear dries out and develops play. GM issued a bulletin that calls for replacing the upper intermediate shaft.
issues.next: It is mostly an annoyance, but have the shaft and the rest of the front end checked at your next service to rule out worn steering parts.

issues.t: "Service 4WD" message from selector switch or position sensor
issues.sym: A Service 4WD message, the lights on the 4WD selector buttons going dark, or the truck staying stuck in one drive mode.
issues.why: The dash selector switch or the position sensor on the transfer case motor wears out or its connector corrodes, so the system no longer knows which mode it is in.
issues.next: Have the 4WD codes read to tell the switch from the sensor before buying parts. Get it fixed before you need four-wheel drive, and sooner if it is stuck in low range.

issues.t: Heater and A/C blend door actuators fail
issues.sym: Clicking or ticking behind the dash, air coming from the wrong vents, or one side blowing hot while the other blows cold.
issues.why: Small electric motors move the doors that direct and mix the air. Their plastic gears strip, so a door sticks or keeps hunting for its position.
issues.next: Not urgent unless you lose defrost. Have a shop find which actuator has failed; some are easy to reach and others need dash trim removed.

issues.t: Dashboard cracks
issues.sym: Cracks in the top of the dashboard, often starting near the passenger airbag or the corners by the windshield, sometimes with a rattle.
issues.why: The dash top on these trucks turns brittle with sun and heat and splits. There was no recall and a class action over it was dismissed.
issues.next: It is cosmetic for most owners. A fitted dash cover hides it; replacing the dash top is the permanent fix.

issues.t: Wipers quit from cracked solder in the wiper control (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers run only sometimes, stop in mid sweep, or do not work at all.
issues.why: Solder joints in the wiper control circuit can crack, which breaks the connection to the motor.
issues.next: Have the control repaired or replaced. Losing the wipers in rain or snow is dangerous.

issues.t: Right front seat belt may not meet crash rules (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing is noticed in normal use; the belt looks and works like any other.
issues.why: The right front restraint was found not to hold an occupant within the required limits in a crash.
issues.next: Have the belt assembly inspected and replaced so the front passenger is properly protected.

issues.t: Four-speed automatic slips or shifts hard
issues.sym: Hard or banging shifts between first and second, the engine flaring between gears, a missing third or fourth gear, or slow reverse.
issues.why: The four-speed automatic behind these V8s wears out its 3-4 clutch piston seal, sun shell and valve body parts, and heat from towing speeds it up. Owner reports for the early trucks put hard shifting at the top of the list.
issues.next: Stop towing and have the fluid and codes checked. Slipping that is left alone burns the clutches and turns a repair into a rebuild.

issues.t: Radio may not have the electronic owner's manual (recall)
issues.sym: The owner information section in the radio menu is empty or will not open.
issues.why: The radio was not set to download the electronic owner's manual, so required safety information is missing from the vehicle.
issues.next: The dealer loads the manual at no charge. Use the printed or online manual until then.
